name: Kuzuhara Mikiko
source:
She married young and became the mother of three daughters, but her first husband passed away.

Later, she met Yuuichi’s father and remarried him. Yuuichi, too, was captivated by her beauty and harbored feelings for her even though she was his stepmother.

Because her husband was so busy with work, they hadn’t been intimate recently, unable to satisfy her desires with her mature body, she had been having repeated affairs behind her family’s back.

A mysterious man obtained photos of her in the act of cheating, which Yuuichi discovered, making her his first target.

Using her betrayal of his father as a pretext, Yuuichi repeatedly humiliated and trained his stepmother.
